text:
raj: Heads-up — planning to flip ff `model-routing-v2` in the 11:30 PDT deploy window. Deploy-bot has a canary scheduled. Goal: 20% ramp over 30m, observe latency + error rate. If p99 > 250ms or errors > 0.5% rollback immediately. Ping @sre-oncall.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: canary start 1711112250, target versions: service/model:v2 -> rollout plan: 20% for 30m -> 60% for 20m -> 100% if green. automated health checks enabled.

maria: can we pin dedicated customers to v1 until we verify? command: `ffctl set model-routing-v2 --percent=0 --scope=dedicated`

cheng: +1 to pin. also add temporary circuit-breaker: if prefix_cache_miss_rate > 5% -> pause ramp and route to v1 fallback.

ben: I'll watch dashboards (latency, errors, cache-miss). creating alert: `alert if p99_latency > 250ms for 5m OR error_rate > 0.5% -> runbook: rollback`

sre-oncall: i'm on for the window. rollback steps in runbook:
```
# rollback quick path
deploy-bot rollback 1711112250
ffctl set model-routing-v2 --percent=0
notify #incidents
```
I'll also open a short ticket if we need a hotfix.

raj: plan: start 20% -> hold 15m -> if stable go to 60% -> hold 20m -> finish. If any alert fires -> rollback immediately. After 100% -> post release note and tag the release. :thumbsup:

olivia: reminder to update console flag description and release notes:
- Add note: "model-routing-v2: improved KV cache locality, expected lower p99 for multi-turn flows"
- list recommended rollout metrics

maria: :eyes: I'll coord with sales for dedicated customers (we'll keep them on v1 until you say green).

ben: ready to watch. tagging @cheng for cache metrics dashboard.

deploy-bot: canary started 1711112250 -> traffic=20%

raj: ok starting the window now. call to action: if you see anything odd, ping here and @sre-oncall.
